Name: Debug Mode
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
[b]Debug Mode[/b] lets you press [font=Courier New]~[/font] to view a debug info overlay, and optionally unlock the game's debug commands (including teleportation and time manipulation).

[b][color=#6aa84f][b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b][/color][/b]


[size=6][b]Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*][i](optional)[/i] [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/DebugMode#configure]Edit the mod settings[/url], including controller/keyboard/mouse mappings.
[/list]

[size=6][b]How to use[/b][/size]
Press the [font=Courier New]~[/font] key (configurable) to toggle debug mode.

[size=4][b]Info overlay[/b][/size]
When enabled, the mod shows an overlay with debug info including...
[list]
[*]cursor crosshairs, tile position, map name, and background song name:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DebugMode/docs/screenshots/world.png[/img][*]menu and submenu names:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DebugMode/docs/screenshots/menu.png[/img][*]event ID, current command, and progress:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DebugMode/docs/screenshots/event.png[/img][*]festival name:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DebugMode/docs/screenshots/festival.png[/img][*]and minigame name:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/DebugMode/docs/screenshots/minigame.png[/img][/list]
[size=4][b]Game debug mode[/b][/size]
If you enable [font=Courier New]AllowGameDebug[/font] in the [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/DebugMode#configure]configuration[/url] (disabled by default), the mod will also enable the game's debug mode and hotkeys:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]T[/font] adds one hour to the clock.
[*][font=Courier New]SHIFT + T[/font] subtract 10 minutes from the clock.
[*][font=Courier New]Y[/font] adds 10 minutes to the clock.
[*][font=Courier New]1[/font] warps the mountain (facing Robin's house).
[*][font=Courier New]2[/font] warps the town (on the path between the town and community center).
[*][font=Courier New]3[/font] warps the farm (at your farmhouse door).
[*][font=Courier New]4[/font] warps the forest (near the traveling cart).
[*][font=Courier New]5[/font] warps the beach (left of Elliott's house).
[*][font=Courier New]6[/font] warps the mine (at the inside entrance).
[*][font=Courier New]7[/font] warps the desert (in Sandy's shop).
[*][font=Courier New]K[/font] moves down one mine level. If not currently in the mine, warp to it.
[*][font=Courier New]F5[/font] toggles the player.
[*][font=Courier New]F7[/font] draws a tile grid.
[*][font=Courier New]B[/font] shifts the toolbar to show the next higher inventory row.
[*][font=Courier New]N[/font] shifts the toolbar to show the next lower inventory row.
[/list]
If you also enable [font=Courier New]AllowDangerousCommands[/font] in the settings (disabled by default), it'll also unlock these debug commands:[list]
[*][font=Courier New]P[/font] immediately goes to bed and starts the next day.
[*][font=Courier New]M[/font] immediately goes to bed and starts the next season.
[*][font=Courier New]H[/font] randomises your hat.
[*][font=Courier New]I[/font] randomises your hair.
[*][font=Courier New]J[/font] randomises your shirt and pants.
[*][font=Courier New]L[/font] randomised your farmer.
[*][font=Courier New]U[/font] randomises your farmhouse wallpaper and floor.
[*][font=Courier New]F10[/font] is broken; it tries to launch a multiplayer server and crashes.
[/list]

[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer (some debug commands may have different effects in multiplayer; see [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/DebugMode#compatibility]multiplayer compatibility notes[/url] for details).
[/list]
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
